sources.name: Model Context Protocol Registry
sources.caveat: Registry breadth measures available integrations and ecosystem supply. It is not evidence of production usage or agentic action volume.

sources.name: Cloudflare Radar
sources.accessMethod: Radar API token stored as a GitHub Actions secret
sources.caveat: Cloudflare sees traffic through its own network. The initial AI-bot metric is MIN0_MAX-normalized, not a raw request count; compare only current and prior windows returned in the same request. AI bot traffic must not be described as all agent activity.

sources.name: Fastly research and network reports
sources.caveat: Fastly's January–May 2026 report used a fixed customer cohort and its own edge-detection labels. Fetchers are a useful agentic-workload proxy, but Fastly's AI traffic is still largely crawler traffic and is not a census of all machine actions.

sources.name: Akamai research and investor relations
sources.caveat: Akamai is both a measurement source and a candidate company. Keep source evidence separate from the investment conclusion.

sources.name: Zscaler ThreatLabz and investor relations
sources.dataType: observed enterprise network proxy and company-reported
sources.caveat: Zscaler only sees its own customer base. Use its traffic and security observations as a longitudinal sample, not the entire enterprise economy.

sources.name: Anthropic Economic Index
sources.caveat: This is a valuable longitudinal sample, not a census of the AI economy.

sources.name: Company investor relations and SEC filings
sources.accessMethod: manual review; selective API adapter later
sources.caveat: Do not conflate reported KPIs, management guidance, analyst consensus, and our scenarios. Fiscal period and GAAP/non-GAAP definitions are required.
